arabic text: ZAMEEN DHOONDH RAHI HAI KIDHAR GAYE HAI HUSAN(A.S)
english translation text: BUT THE GROUND IS LOOKING FOR HUSSAIN.

arabic text: KAREGA SHIMR KA KHANJAR TO SIRF SAR KO JUDA
english translation text: SHIMARS DAGGER WILL ONLY SEPARATE THE HEAD FROM HIS BODY

arabic text: WAGAR NA LAASHAE AKBAR PE MARGAYE HAI HUSAIN(A.S)
english translation text: BUT HUSSAIN HAS ACTUALLY DIED(SPIRITUALLY) NEAR THE BODY OF HZ ALIAKBER.

arabic text: SARE BURIDA KATE HOT KHOON CHEHRE PAR
english translation text: HIS HEAD IS SEVERED, HIS LIPS TORN AND THERE IS BLOOD ON HIS FACE

arabic text: AJEEB HAAL ME SHIRI KE GHAR AYE HAI HUSAIN(A.S)
english translation text: WHAT A STRANGE WAY TO GO TO THE HOUSE OF SHEERIN, OH HUSSAIN

arabic text: MAI MILNE SHAAM KE ZINDAA ME AAUNGA TUJHSE
english translation text: I WILL COME TO MEET YOU IN THE PRISON OF SHAAM

arabic text: YE BAAT AAKHRI BETI SE KARGAYE HAI HUSAIN(A.S)
english translation text: THESE WERE THE LAST WORDS TO HIS DAUGHTER FROM HUSSAIN

arabic text: KAHI HAI QASIMO ABBAS AUR KAHI AKBAR
english translation text: QASIM IS AT ONE PLACE, ABBAS AT ANOTHER AND AKBAR SOMEWHERE ELSE

arabic text: KAHA KAHA TERE TUKDE PADE HUE HAI HUSAIN(A.S)
QAZA KE BAAD BHI BHAI BEHEN KE SAATH RAHA
english translation text: EVEN AFTER HIS DEATH THE BROTHER AND SISTER STAYED TOGETHER

arabic text: JIDHAR JIDHAR GAYI ZAINAB UDHAR GAYE HAI HUSAIN(A.S)
english translation text: WHEREVER ZAINAB WENT, HUSSAIN WENT TOO.

arabic text: KISI NE MAARA HAI PATHHAR BEHEN KE KYA AKBAR
english translation text: SOMEBODY HIT A STONE ON HIS SISTER, OH AKBAR

arabic text: KE KARTE KARTE TILAWAT THAHAR GAYE HAI HUSAIN
english translation text: THAT’S WHY HUSSAIN HAS SUDDENLY STOPPED RECITING THE QURAN
